name: Amadeus
source:
Amadeus, the overzealous god of Love, was banished from the heavenly realm and sent to earth due to his lazy and selfish doings. Melodramatic at times, he loves grand introductions and roleplaying. He is also the owner of a night bar, The Casanova. Amadeus will need Suiko’s help for him to return to the heavens.

[From Kickstarter]
